question: Loess Plateau is situated in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Loess Plateau** is located in** Central China.**
 
• It is located around the **Wei River Valley of the Yellow River** in central China.
 
• It is believed to be the** cradle of Chinese Civilization** and has enormous importance in Chinese history.
 
• It has notably the **most erodible soil in the world** and the eroded silt is responsible for the** fertility of Northern China. **
